pillars.name: Market & Sharp Pricing
pillars.desc: Fitted log-linear sharp-book fair probability (mine / fair_prob), calibrated edge %, best book letter (Book A–W) & price, 24h line movement (mv24), open vs. current line, hold/vig %

pillars.name: Empirical Hit-Rate Windows & Distributions
pillars.desc: L5, L10, and L20/Season empirical hit rates %, L10 median vs. mean & line delta, 10th-percentile floor & 90th-percentile ceiling band, home/away venue splits

pillars.name: Deployment, Usage & Injury Cascades
pillars.desc: Minutes/TOI/snap share trends (L5 vs Season), injury status (inj), starting lineup/goalie confirmation, With-or-Without (wo) teammate injury redistribution deltas

pillars.name: Tactical Matchup & Environment
pillars.desc: Positional DvP rank (#1–#32) & allowed rate, pace/total environment (ttl, implied team total itt), goalie/pitcher/referee/weather context

pillars.name: Conviction Gatekeeper & Two-Way Audit
pillars.desc: Two-way quantitative + situational/strategic/tactical validation (CONFIRMED_HIGH_CONVICTION, CAUTION_HOLD, TRAP_FILTERED), quant_vs_contextual_delta, risk/payoff grade, and entry timing

validation_backtest.methodology: Two-Stage Walk-Forward Backtest (Read-Only on Graded Historical Logs; Strictly Pre-Game Signals Only)

player_props_backtest.sample_description: Graded Single-Leg Player Props (recs_history.json + pre-game logs)

execution_score_backtest.methodology: Walk-forward on graded single-leg ledger; daily top 10 by unified Execution Score vs daily top 10 by raw quant edge; calibration term uses only prior-day results.
